support.standalone_contract: src/Falah.Application/Employees/EmployeeRequests.cs:57-63 and src/Falah.Server/Program.cs:732-735 state standalone PAY EMPLOYEE pays the continuous running balance at any time, up to currently owed balance, without a payroll run; payroll is separately period-run-gated.
support.creation: src/Falah.Infrastructure/Employees/CreatePayrollHandler.cs:45-62 selects all employee ledger entries in UTC year/month, computes lines, and stores frozen NetPayablePiastres.
support.calculation: src/Falah.Domain/Payroll/PayrollRules.cs:95-107 includes eligible earnings less Deduction/Adjustment, but not Settlement.
support.pay: src/Falah.Infrastructure/Employees/PayPayrollHandler.cs:86-88,136-163 pays the frozen net and writes PayrollSettlement; inspected write path does not recompute current employee balance or net prior Settlement.
support.availability: Both routes and same cashier application flows exist; independent permissions differ (employees_ledger vs payroll_pay), and a user with both can invoke both absent server cross-flow guard.
support.docs: docs/IMPLEMENTATION_MATRIX.md:98-99 states payroll is no longer the only employee payment path.

counterevidence_and_limits: Distinct ledger types and distinct permissions can be intentional separate modes; source has no exclusivity/settlement-netting rule, and separate permissions alone do not prove mutual exclusion.

Existing PayEmployeeVerticalSliceTests assert Settlement distinct from PayrollSettlement; PayrollVerticalSliceTests verify the independent calculation/payment path. Inspected tests do not cover same-period combined sequence.
